findings.evidence: Lines 142–143 name `orthogonalCap ∘ₗ orthogonalCup` as `orthogonalCap_comp_orthogonalCup`, but lines 154–155 define `orthogonalCapCup` as `orthogonalCup k n ∘ₗ orthogonalCap k n`; the naming guide requires names to describe expressions in their written order.
findings.fix: Rename it to `orthogonalCupCap` (and rename all dependent `orthogonalCapCup_*` declarations), or use an order-neutral standard name such as `orthogonalBrauerGenerator`.
findings.issue: `orthogonalCapCup` is defined as `orthogonalCup ∘ₗ orthogonalCap`, while the same file names the opposite-order composite `orthogonalCap_comp_orthogonalCup`; the base name therefore misleadingly reverses the established outward-to-inward composition order.

summary: The composite generator’s name reverses the written composition order and propagates that ambiguity through its API.
